Only one Active Employee should hold a given key at a time; if you set the same key on a second Active Employee, WhatsApp routing will pick whichever ERPNext returns first — resolve the duplicate quickly.
label: LMD Role Key
name: Employee-custom_role_key

description: Optional context — e.g. 'Acting HoO from 2026-03-01 to 2026-04-30' or 'Backup PM for Aseese while Adewale on leave'.
label: LMD Role Notes
name: Employee-custom_role_notes
